description: BetterPvPSprint is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that gives you full control over sprinting in PvP and survival scenarios.

mods.name: BetterPvPSprint
mods.description: Client-side Fabric mod that adds toggleable auto sprint with separate land and water controls, a custom keybind category, and automatic sprint handling based on movement, hunger, and environment, including diagonal movement support.
